section_summary.extract_value: The section describes a single study in which the authors prepared a Romanian translation of the BAS-2 and evaluated its factor structure and psychometric properties in a sample of Romanian adults. They planned analyses of dimensionality (EFA and CFA), internal consistency, sex invariance and sex differences, three-week test–retest reliability, and convergent validity including associations with BMI and other constructs.
